title: A Border for the Asset
author: E. M. Dunmore
blurb: Jonah Villalobos, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
